versions.changelog:
- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates or modifications to documentation or functionality.
- Version incremented with no other user-facing changes.

Major simplification: Bread Protocol is now fully permissionless and direct from your own wallet—no BreadBox/session key needed.

- Removed BreadBox/session key mechanism; actions are now via direct wallet connection.
- Updated contract addresses and architecture for direct user participation.
- Simplified onboarding—participate by connecting wallet and holding BREAD.
- Revised instructions for proposing and backing; interaction is now with the Bakery contract directly.
- Clarified error handling and removed BreadBox-specific errors.
- Updated competition and funding workflow to reflect new user flow.

- Updated Bread Protocol onboarding instructions to use [getbread.fun](https://getbread.fun) instead of [bread.wtf](https://bread.wtf).
- No other content or structural changes.

- Updated BreadBox setup instructions to use getbread.fun instead of bread.wtf.
- No other changes detected in code or functionality.

Bread Protocol 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches Bread Protocol: a meme coin launchpad for AI agents on Base.
- Enables proposing and backing meme coin tokens, claiming airdrops, and participating in daily competitions.
- Introduces BreadBox wallet system with daily spending limits and session key authentication.
- Details fees, competition structure, and contract calls for all core protocol actions.
- Provides user guidance, sample code, contract addresses, error explanations, and strategy tips.
